messages.content:
Several readers answered the same question about machines at work, each pointing at the sentences it
used. Decide which answer the evidence supports. Use only the evidence shown; do not use what you know.

Rules:
- An answer is supported only if its evidence states it for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the
  same article and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline, the same condition the question
  states). Evidence about a neighbouring subject does not support an answer.
- When answers rest on texts of different rank, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's
  manual, then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.)
  wins over a ministerial decree (DM). A wording corrected by a corrigendum replaces the original wording.
- For a list, prefer the answer whose items are each stated by the evidence and that leaves none out.
- Readers that found nothing are listed too: when most readers found nothing and the one answer shown rests on
  evidence about a neighbouring subject, choose "none".
Return JSON only: {"reasoning": "two or three short sentences", "choice": <the number of the answer supported, or "none">}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: On 1 March 2027 a manufacturer places a vehicle servicing lift on the market. Among which conformity assessment procedures may it choose?

Answer 1 (given by 1 reader(s): facts): ["module B followed by module C", "module H", "module G"]
Under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, Article 25(2) and Annex I, Part A, point 3 (vehicle servicing lifts), the manufacturer may choose EU type-examination (module B) followed by module C, full quality assurance (module H), or unit verification (module G).
Evidence:
- vehicle servicing lifts: listedIn = Vehicle servicing lifts | sentence: "3. Vehicle servicing lifts." [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
- machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A: requiresProcedure = specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2) | sentence: "Machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part A, shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2), and machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part B shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3)." [REG, Art. 6(1)]
- category of machinery or related product: requiresProcedure = conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "(b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX;" [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- category of machinery or related product: requiresProcedure = conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "(c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X." [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- manufacturer: hasObligation = shall apply one of the following procedures (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures:" [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- Directive 2006/42/EC: repealedFrom = 20 January 2027 | sentence: "read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’." [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5]
- Regulation: appliesFrom = 20 January 2027 (condition: However, the following Articles shall apply from the following dates) | sentence: "read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’." [CORR, Corrigendum, point 10]
- category of machinery or related product: requiresProcedure = EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "(a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII;" [REG, Art. 25(2)]

Answer 2 (given by 1 reader(s): similar): ["EU-type examination (Annex IV Part B) followed by final inspection (Annex V)", "EU-type examination (Annex IV Part B) followed by conformity to type based on product quality assurance (Annex X)", "EU-type examination (Annex IV Part B) followed by conformity to type based on production quality assurance (Annex XII)", "design and manufacture under an approved quality system (Annex XI) followed by final inspection (Annex V)", "design and manufacture under an approved quality system (Annex XI) followed by conformity to type based on product quality assurance (Annex X)", "design and manufacture under an approved quality system (Annex XI) followed by conformity to type based on production quality assurance (Annex XII)", "conformity based on unit verification (Annex VIII)", "conformity based on full quality assurance plus design examination (Annex XI)"]
Under Article 16(1) of Directive 2014/33/EU, a lift may follow one of the listed procedures, with the choice between EU-type examination routes, approved quality system routes, unit verification (Annex VIII) and full quality assurance plus design examination (Annex XI); the passages do not confirm whether vehicle servicing lifts are in scope.
Evidence:
- Read on demand: eu-dir-2014-33, Art. 16(1) | sentence: "Lifts shall be subject to one of the following conformity assessment procedures" [eu-dir-2014-33, Art. 16(1)]
- Read on demand: eu-dir-2014-33, Art. 16(1) | sentence: "(c) conformity based on unit verification for lifts set out in Annex VIII" [eu-dir-2014-33, Art. 16(1)]
- Read on demand: eu-dir-2014-33, Art. 16(1) | sentence: "(d) conformity based on full quality assurance plus design examination for lifts set out in Annex XI" [eu-dir-2014-33, Art. 16(1)]

Answer 3 (given by 1 reader(s): search): ["EU type-examination (module B) followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C)", "conformity based on full quality assurance (module H)", "conformity based on unit verification (module G)"]
Under the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, Article 25(2) and Annex I, Part A, point 3 (vehicle servicing lifts), the manufacturer may choose module B+C, module H, or module G; the Regulation applies from 20 January 2027, before the 1 March 2027 placing on the market.
Evidence:
- Found by search: REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3 | sentence: "3. Vehicle servicing lifts." [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
- Found by search: REG, Art. 25(2) | sentence: "Article 25 Conformity assessment procedures for machinery and related products. 2. Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII; (b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX; (c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X." [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- Found by search: REG, Art. 54 (corrected by the corrigendum (Corrigendum, point 10: '14 January 2027' now reads '20 January 2027'; Corrigendum, point 11: '14 January 2024' now reads '20 January 2024'; Corrigendum, point 12: '14 October 2023' now reads '20 October 2026'; Corrigendum, point 13: '13 July 2023' now reads '19 July 2023'; Corrigendum, point 14: '14 July 2024' now reads '20 July 2024')) | sentence: "Article 54 Entry into force and application This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union . It shall apply from 20 January 2027." [REG, Art. 54]

Readers that found nothing: words

response.text: {"reasoning": "Vehicle servicing lifts are listed in Annex I, Part A, point 3 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, so Article 25(2) applies, offering module B+C, module H, or module G. The Regulation applies from 20 January 2027 (corrected), before 1 March 2027. Answer 2 concerns Directive 2014/33/EU on lifts for persons, a neighbouring subject, and does not confirm that vehicle servicing lifts are in scope. Answers 1 and 3 are consistent.", "choice": 1}
